details.label: R328
details.text: `[HIGH]` [#32272](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32272) ([`1a120754`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/1a120754e00bfe6bf3d3a0e8ab912157934c0f41)) puts each layer's K and V halves into one allocation in `MHATokenToKVPool`, with no ROCm gate. Mooncake's HIP transport then delivers corrupt KV to decode.
The commit is in AI but not in AH (checked with the compare API).
#46861 reports a PR-CI bisect: 9/9 passes on bases before the commit and 9/9 failures at or after it.
The disaggregation job dispatched on #46875 passes on rocm10.

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: nobody has identified the step inside Mooncake that misplaces the data, and the gate has been validated only on rocm10.

details.label: R333
details.text: `[MEDIUM]` the same commit. Inside the compiled `forward_decode`, writes go to aliased K/V views of a base buffer with more than 2³¹ elements.

details.label: Disconfirming

The window [`911693e3..cb55d77d`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/compare/911693e3f816b32c40ee1cd8a98f390da3a18297...cb55d77d37c5f982e75edfd7f4a016f6a6ad35a1) has 66 other commits, and not all of them were ruled out.
